n_cf0d0109e678e5f6.name: Check the search run
n_cf0d0109e678e5f6.source: export default function run({initial,current,previous}){const x=current??initial;if(!x||typeof x.id!=='string'||!x.id||typeof x.status!=='string')throw Error('Invalid Actor run');if(previous?.id&&previous.id!==x.id)throw Error('Actor run changed');if(['FAILED','ABORTED','TIMED-OUT'].includes(x.status))throw Error('Actor failed');const done=x.status==='SUCCEEDED',count=(previous?.count??0)+1;if(!done&&count>80)throw Error('Actor wait exceeded');if(done&&(!x.defaultDatasetId||!x.defaultKeyValueStoreId))throw Error('Actor output IDs missing');return{state:{id:x.id,count},done,runId:x.id,datasetId:x.defaultDatasetId??'pending',storeId:x.defaultKeyValueStoreId??'pending'};}

n_c19ae8030c229bb2.name: Read and process every page
n_c19ae8030c229bb2.source: export default function pages({previous,items}){const s=previous??{phase:'preflight',offset:0,awaiting:false};if(s.awaiting){if(!Array.isArray(items)||items.length>100)throw Error('Invalid dataset page');if(s.phase==='preflight'){if(items.length===100)s.offset+=100;else{s.phase='process';s.offset=0}}else{if(items.length===0){s.phase='done'}else{s.page=items.map(x=>{if(!x||typeof x.platform!=='string'||typeof x.companySlug!=='string'||typeof x.jobId!=='string'||!x.platform||!x.companySlug||!x.jobId)throw Error('Job identity missing');return{key:x.platform+':'+x.companySlug+':'+x.jobId,company:x.company||x.companySlug,title:x.title??'',location:x.location??'',url:x.applyUrl??''}});s.last=items.length<100;s.index=0;s.phase='items'}}s.awaiting=false}if(s.phase==='items'){if(s.index<s.page.length){const item=s.page[s.index++];return{state:s,action:'item',offset:s.offset,item}}if(s.last)s.phase='done';else{s.offset+=100;s.phase='process'}}if(s.phase==='done')return{state:s,action:'done',offset:s.offset,item:{}};s.awaiting=true;return{state:s,action:'page',offset:s.offset,item:{}};}

n_419a50ed8cd1381c.name: Prepare the history lookup
n_419a50ed8cd1381c.source: export default function lookup({item}){if(typeof item.key!=='string'||!item.key)throw Error('Invalid job');const v=item.key.replaceAll('\\','\\\\').replaceAll("'","\\'");return{formula:"{Job key}='"+v+"'",records:[{fields:{'Job key':item.key}}]};}

n_03586c81877f78bf.name: Confirm the history record
n_03586c81877f78bf.source: export default function confirm({records}){if(!Array.isArray(records)||records.length!==1||!records[0]?.id)throw Error('History write not confirmed');return{ok:true};}

n_9b5a38292243ee3a.name: Prepare the job alert
n_9b5a38292243ee3a.source: export default function message({item}){const esc=x=>String(x??'').replaceAll('&','&').replaceAll('<','<').replaceAll('>','>');return{text:`${esc(item.company)} is hiring: ${esc(item.title)} (${esc(item.location)}) ${esc(item.url)}`};}
